titulo: Why your old phone really gets slower 🐢
descripcion: Apps get heavier every year, storage fills up, and worn batteries can't deliver peak power. In 2020 Apple agreed to pay up to $500 million over slowing iPhones with old batteries.

escenas.texto: Your phone was lightning fast the day you bought it. Two years later, it feels like it's stuck in mud. Is it on purpose?
Reason one: apps keep getting heavier. Every update adds features, built for newer, faster phones.
Reason two: full storage. When your phone is almost full, it has less room to work, and everything slows down.
Reason three: a worn battery can't deliver bursts of power, so the phone slows its processor to avoid shutting off.
In twenty twenty, Apple agreed to pay up to five hundred million dollars in a lawsuit over slowing down iPhones with older batteries.
So, free up space and replace a tired battery. It can feel like a new phone. Follow for more tech secrets.
